name: code-humanizer
description: Make AI-generated code look more natural, varied, and human-written with live preview and style controls.

enumDescriptions: Light touch: remove stereotypical AI comments and extra blank lines.
Balanced: clean AI phrasing, normalize spacing, and apply moderate style shifts.
Heavy: stronger stylistic shifts and persona adjustments while keeping logic intact.
codeHumanizer.intensity.description: Controls how strongly the code is humanized.

enumDescriptions: Clean and natural code without robotic AI commentary.
Fast, direct, and minimal code written for quick execution.
Beginner-like code with simple structure and short variable names where safe.

codeHumanizer.removeAiComments.description: Remove verbose or stereotypical AI-style comments.

codeHumanizer.shortVariablesInBeginnerMo.description: Use short or single-letter local variable names when style is set to beginner.
